Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — great discussion. Per our conversation, I wanted to summarize the compliance items you flagged and propose next steps so procurement & security can move quickly:

- Primary asks from your security team: SOC 2 Type II report, a signed bridge letter or temporary attestation, and read-only access to our trust portal for evidence and reports.
- Regulatory concerns to confirm: HIPAA data handling for PHI and GDPR residency for EU-subject data (you mentioned potential EU customers in scope).

3) If you want, share the VSQ now — we can start answers in parallel (portal preferred). Expected turnaround: 2–4 business days for initial artifacts, full answers depend on questionnaire size.

Attaching a short SOC 2 highlights PDF for your engineering/security review.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the access and ping you when Marissa has the invite ready.

Best,
